test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 11 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that rectifies the incorrectly spelt words in the given sentence.**

The young worms are fedd tendar leaves.

options.text: The young worms are fed tander leaves.
The young worms are fed tender leaves.
The young worms are fed tendor leaves.
The young worms are feid tendre leaves.

solution:
The incorrectly spelt word is: Fedd and Tendar

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 

 
• Only in Option 2, the spellings of **fed and tender** are correct. 
 
• That's why Option 2 is marked as the correct answer.
 
• 1. Fedd = The correct spelling is Fed.
 
 
• Fed is the past form of feed, which means an act of giving food, especially to animals or a baby. (भोजन देने की क्रिया, विशेष रूप से जानवरों या बच्चों को)
 
 
 
• 2. Tendar = The correct spelling is Tender.
 
 
• Tender leaves mean soft and young leaves. (कोमल पत्ती)
 
 
 
• So, from here we can say that except for option 2 rest of the options are incorrect.

Therefore, option 2 is the correct answer.

**Corrected sentence:** *The young worms are fed tender leaves.*
